vendroid.description: Vendroid brings Ventoy to Android, letting you create and manage multiboot USB drives directly from your phone without root access or a PC. Install Ventoy, detect existing installations, and update or repair supported drives while preserving their files. It includes official Ventoy files for offline use, optional online updates, customizable installation settings, and built-in verification to check that data was written correctly. Once installed, simply copy your ISO files to the USB drive and choose which one to boot when starting your computer.
